name: hf_ccpvtz_dipole
description: #627: hf_ccpvtz's molecule in Cartesian cc-pVTZ with its f shells kept (F 4s3p2d1f, H 3s2p1d), so every class (ss) through (ff) occurs, each class with one f between the two centres. libcint's int1e_r_cart (<m|r - C|n>, components x, y, z) under mol.with_common_orig(C) at C = (0.37, -0.81, 1.23) bohr and at C = 0, and libcint's int1e_ovlp (as ovlp). No density and no dip_moment.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate hf_ccpvtz_dipole

density_recipe: none: a density-free fixture records no density and nothing computed from one (#520)
